components.role: Gondor: shared Standard Rules and Gondor Exclusive Rules
Sauron: shared Standard Rules, Sauron Exclusive Rules, charts, counters and map
War of the Ring original charts and tables

middle-earth.evidence: Original SPI licensed Tolkien collection, not the unrelated later War of the Ring games. The War of the Ring original parts inventory explicitly identifies the Middle Earth package and its Gondor/Sauron rules and components. Original covers, copyright, contents, credits, common rules and exclusive introductions were checked. The unchanged 28-page War of the Ring book covers the Character Game, Campaign Game and three-player Saruman option. Its setup, Character sequence, Ring/quest victory, Campaign setup and victory and three-player sequence passages were read. Both Gondor and Sauron packets retain their separately scanned common four-page Standard Rules; duplicate common rules have not been silently merged. Their exclusive setup, game length and victory passages and common movement/phase rules were read. Gondor is the Minas Tirith siege; Sauron is the Second Age Alliance battle. The Sauron packet includes original charts, counter fronts/backs and map; the map and counter fronts were visually inspected. Original War of the Ring and Gondor chart packets are retained separately; selected original chart images were inspected. All 53 PDF pages received fresh English OCR because their native text layers were empty. Rotated charts, card/counter sheets, numerical cells and diagrams remain poorly transcribed in places; unchanged original images govern exact values and alignment. This is usable original rules coverage for all three named games, not certification of a complete playable print-and-play set, all cards or every optional ruling. No specific contradiction is established in the very general local summary by this source review. It remains Unverified, without a PASS or summary-body repair.

components.role: Included matching SNIPER! Standard Rules, copyright 1987 TSR
Bug Hunter Scenario Book, copyright 1988 TSR
Bug Hunter original covers and reference tables, including sequence and activation aids
Bug Hunter original predator-power and random weapon-effect cards

bug-hunter.evidence: Original Bug Hunter SNIPER! companion game, TSR 1988, matching the named local game and BGG 5940. The original 16-page Special Rules explicitly lists the included 24-page Standard Rules, 8-page Scenario Book and two cardstock sheets. All are recovered unchanged, with original cover/title/copyright/contents and special-rule inventory checked. The archive filename SniperBugHuntRules.pdf contains the correct 1987 Standard Rules; it is not the Bug Hunter Special Rules book. The older 1986 Sniper second-edition and Hetzer Special Rules PDFs were inspected and excluded rather than substituted. Bug Hunter Special Rules override Standard Rules, including human/alien panic, preservation and predator activation. Reviewed core passages include Standard course of play, complete sequence and activation, direct/opportunity fire and hand-to-hand tasks; Bug Hunter original introduction, terrain, predator types/powers/activation/panic/movement and self-destruct excerpts; Scenario setup, general ending and Contact complete setup/length/victory rules. The original Standard sequence page 3 and Special predator activation page 14 were visually checked, as were original Bug Hunter sequence/combat reference tables and a random weapon-effect card sheet. All 56 PDF pages received fresh English OCR because native text layers were empty. Original images govern rotated cards/charts, numerical values, icons and table alignment; the OCR is not a verified reconstruction of playable components. Full rules/scenarios are retained, but not every scenario, optional rule or numerical cell was independently audited and complete maps/counters are not certified. One specific MAJOR turn-structure finding is recorded; no full summary audit, PASS or summary-body repair.

excluded_sources.bug-sniper-tsr2: Older 1986 second-edition Sniper rules; excluded in favor of the included matching 1987 Standard Rules.
excluded_sources.bug-hetzer-common: Hetzer WWII Special Rules; not Bug Hunter or its shared Standard Rules.
